players.bio: Álvaro José Zamora Mata (born 9 March 2002) is a Costa Rican professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Costa Rican club Deportivo Saprissa and the Costa Rica national team. Zamora made his national team debut for Costa Rica in a friendly against South Korea national football team on 23 September 2022. He came in as a substitute for Gerson Torres at half-time.
André Filipe Lopes Almeida (born 16 May 1995) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a central defender for Liga Portugal 2 club Académico de Viseu.
André Clóvis Silva Filho (born 21 November 1997), commonly known as André Clóvis, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a striker forAcadémico de Viseu.
Cihan Kahraman (born 8 October 1998) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Portuguese club Académico de Viseu.
Diogo Rafael dos Santos Almeida (born 8 September 2000) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a striker for Nacional in Liga Portugal 2.

Famana Quizera (born 25 April 2002) is a Bissau-Guinean professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Liga Portugal 2 club Académico de Viseu and the Guinea-Bissau national team.
Henrique Martins Gomes (born 30 November 1995) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Académico de Viseu.
Juan Soriano Oropesa (born 23 August 1997) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper .
Marco Antonio Marsulo Junior (born 5 April 2002), commonly known as Marquinho, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Liga Portugal 2 club Académico de Viseu.
Miguel Ángel Brau Blánquez (born 27 December 2001) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Coventry City.

Miguel Bandarra Rodrigues (born 17 January 1996) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Liga Portugal 2 club Académico de Viseu. He made his Taça da Liga debut for Farense on 27 July 2019 in a game against Académica.
Mohamed Aidara (born 6 November 1996) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Académico Viseu in the Liga Portugal 2.
Mohamed Bouldini (Arabic: محمد بولديني; born 27 November 1995) is a Moroccan footballer who plays as a forward for Spanish club Deportivo de La Coruña.
Nils Mortimer Moreno (born 11 June 2001) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a winger for Nacional. He is a former Spanish youth international.
Soufiane Messeguem (born 5 February 2001) is a German professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Portuguese club Académico de Viseu.
Valery Fernández Estrada (born 23 November 1999), also simply known as Valery, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right-back or a winger for Real Zaragoza.
Yuri Nascimento de Araujo, known as Yuri (born 13 April 1996), is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Liga Portugal 2 club Académico de Viseu.
